name: Interlock-permissive discrepancy alarm
summary: Detects disagreement between the commanded permission and the expected interlock feedback.
description: Detects disagreement between the commanded permission and the expected interlock feedback. An interlocking function permits or blocks an operation according to the positions and conditions of related equipment. Electrical, mechanical and trapped-key interlocks implement different parts of a coordinated operating philosophy.

In a switchgear feeder panel, a control diagram can prevent an incompatible combination of breaker, disconnector and earthing-switch positions. The physical equipment documents determine which restrictions are mechanically enforced. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Permission and feedback” at the input and “Interlock discrepancy alarm” at the output. Alarm logic does not replace physical interlocking.
